answers.core: In comparison, many IDEs support cloning projects from arbitrary locations directly.
answers.workaround: This can be worked around by `curl` or `git` in a terminal, but it adds a small extra step to cloning an external project. You could open Godot from the command line after downloading the project, but this means it won't be added to the project list unless it's in the autoscan location (and you've configured autoscan in the Editor Settings).

title: Add support for importing projects from URLs in the project manager
